description: Ratified Kairos' Council figure-signature canon (cross-product canon, ratified 2026-07-19): 9 signature templates and 35 carrier figures with template assignment, one-line historical argument, parameterization, and primary forge. Input: `figure` (name or slug) for one figure, or `template` (T1–T9 or name) for a template and all its carriers. Static canon data — deterministic. Costs 1 call.

figure.description: Figure name or slug, e.g. "Joan of Arc" or "joan-of-arc". Returns that figure's canon record.

template.description: Signature template id (T1–T9) or name (e.g. "Last Testament"). Returns the template and every ratified carrier.

name: signature_lookup
